acmeHint: Optional: with it, Traefik gets certificates for HTTPS sites.
caddyTls: Caddy gets and renews the certificate on its own.
domainsHint: Separated by commas. They must point at this machine.
duplicate: Two sites have the same name.
installBody: {server} is installed as root and started.
installNote: {server} is not installed on this machine.
invalidName: A site name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
invalidUpstream: The address is http:// or https:// and a host, without spaces or quotes.
needsCertificate: HTTPS with nginx needs a certificate and key file.
needsResolver: Traefik has no certificate resolver: install it with an e-mail address for Let's Encrypt.
notWritable: This Traefik does not read ServerBox's folder (/etc/traefik/dynamic): add it as a file provider to its configuration.
progressHint: You can close this window; the agent carries on.
refused: The server refused the new configuration and kept the previous one: {detail}
removeBody: Requests for it will no longer be sent on.
saveBody: {domains} will be sent on to {upstream}. The server checks the new configuration and keeps the previous one if it refuses.
title: Reverse proxy
wafEventsBody: The firewall's log is readable by root alone.
wafFirstSave: Save once before turning it on for a site.
wafInstallNginx: ModSecurity for nginx and the OWASP Core Rule Set are installed from the machine's packages.
wafInstallTraefik: nginx with ModSecurity and the OWASP Core Rule Set are installed from the machine's packages to check Traefik's requests on this machine, the ModSecurity plugin is added to Traefik's configuration and Traefik restarted; the plugin is fetched from the network.
wafNotInstallable: This Traefik's configuration is not ServerBox's: add the ModSecurity plugin to it by hand.
wafNotSet: Save the firewall's settings before turning it on for a site.
wafSaveBlock: Requests the rules score as attacks will be refused with 403. Watch the events for false positives.
wafSaveDetect: Rules run and what they match is logged; nothing is refused.
wafSaveOff: The rules will not run for any site.
wafSitesNote: Turn it on for a site in the site's settings.
